name: Touhou Kenchinroku
source:
"Could you show me your masturbation?"

A mysterious pretty girl introduces herself to a porn film director (the lead character).
Her name is Yukari, and she says she is a specter and has been feeding herself with human body, but she intends to eat sperm instead as a main meal in the future.
And for that, she looks for a man who has a good c*ck for that purpose.

This is the first volume of the game and story continues to the next volume.

This is a sound novel based on the characters of Touhou.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065288.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“你可以让我看看你的自慰吗？”

一位神秘的漂亮女孩向一位色情电影导演（主角）介绍自己。
她的名字叫由香里，自称是幽灵，一直以人类的身体为食，但她打算将来以精子作为主食。
为此，她寻找一个拥有良好阴茎的男人。

这是游戏的第一卷，故事将继续到下一卷。

这是一部以东方人物为背景的有声小说。
